attorneys: Mr. William L. Curtis for petitioner. Messrs. Harry P. Daily and John P. Woods for respondent. By special leave of Court, Solicitor General Jackson and Mr. Mastín G. White filed a memorandum on behalf of the United States, as amicus curiae, in support of the petition.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit granted.
